Tooltip_SLS_SaltLick: A block of livestock salt. Break off chunks with a hammer or hammerstone.
Tooltip_SLS_DirtySalt: Too dirty to eat. Dissolve it in a pot of water and boil it dry.
Tooltip_SLS_Brine: Boil on a stove or campfire until the water is gone.
Tooltip_SLS_PotOfSalt: Scrape the salt out with a spoon, fork, knife or other kitchen utensil.
